steps.message:
# Prove Cauchy's theorem in Isabelle/Isar from the basic group axioms

`/app/Cauchy.lean` is one Lean 4 (Mathlib) proof of Cauchy's theorem: if a prime `p` divides the
order of a finite group `G`, then `G` has an element of order `p`. It is a reference, not a
template. Your only task is to prove the Isabelle theorem in `/app/Cauchy.thy`, by any route you
like, within the requirements below.

`/app/Group_Axioms.thy` defines a locale `grp` from the basic axioms only: closure, associativity,
a **left** identity `e` and **left** inverses `ginv`. It also defines `prime` (from divisibility)
and natural powers `pow x n` (`pow x 0 = e`, `pow x (Suc n) = x \<cdot> pow x n`). Every other group
fact you need (right identity, right inverses, cancellation, laws of powers, ...) must be derived
from these axioms in your own file. `Main` provides only general mathematics: sets, `finite`,
`card`, lists, natural-number arithmetic, `dvd`, `gcd`, and function iteration `f ^^ n`.

`/app/Cauchy.thy` states the theorem and ends in `sorry`. Replace the `sorry` with a complete proof.
Isabelle2025 is installed (`isabelle` is on `PATH`) with a prebuilt `HOL` heap; check your work
from `/app` with:

```sh
timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /app
```

## Working in the sandbox

- Only `/app/Cauchy.thy` is graded; nothing else in the sandbox is kept. Keep your current best
  version there as you go.
- You have 60 minutes.
- `isabelle build` prints nothing until the session finishes, and a looping `simp`/`auto`/`blast` can
  run indefinitely. Wrap builds in `timeout`, e.g. `timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /app`.
  The grader allows 8 minutes for the whole build.
- `isabelle process` may not exit on its own; use `isabelle build`.

## Requirements

- Keep the theory name and the statement `theorem (in grp) cauchy: assumes ... shows ...`
  unchanged (you may name the assumptions). You may add your own definitions and lemmas before it.
- Allowed imports: `Main` and `Group_Axioms` only. Do not modify `/app/Group_Axioms.thy` or
  `/app/ROOT`; the grader uses its own copies.
- `/app/Cauchy.thy` must be at most **600 lines** in total.
- Write the proof in structured Isar: `proof ... qed` blocks built from named facts and
  `have`/`show`/`obtain` steps (`from`, `with`, `hence`, `thus`, `also`/`finally`, `moreover` are
  all fine), with at least four such steps in the proof of `cauchy` itself. It should read like a
  textbook argument, with the key ideas stated as their own lemmas.
- Forbidden anywhere in the file: `apply`-style scripts (`apply`, `done`, `back`, `defer`, `prefer`), `sorry`, `oops`, `smt`, `sledgehammer`, `nitpick`, `nunchaku`, `quickcheck`, `axiomatization`, `axioms`, `oracle`, `skip_proofs`, `quick_and_dirty`, `tactic`, `raw_tactic`, and every ML, setup, syntax and translation command (`ML`, `ML_*`, `SML_*`, `setup`, `local_setup`, `method_setup`, `attribute_setup`, `simproc_setup`, `declaration`, `syntax_declaration`, `syntax`, `no_syntax`, `translations`, `*_translation`). Comments, cartouches and strings are not scanned.
  Ordinary methods such as `metis`, `meson`, `rule`, `simp`, `auto`, `blast`, `arith`, `unfold`, `.` and `..` are
  allowed.
I'll start by reading the reference files and the theory skeleton.

theory Group_Axioms
  imports Main
begin

text \<open>A group given only by the basic axioms: closure, associativity, a left identity and left
  inverses. Nothing else about groups is available; right-sided laws must be derived.\<close>

locale grp =
  fixes G :: "'a set"
    and mult :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"  (infixl \<open>\<cdot>\<close> 70)
    and e :: 'a
    and ginv :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a"
  assumes closed: "\<lbrakk>x \<in> G; y \<in> G\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> x \<cdot> y \<in> G"
    and assoc: "\<lbrakk>x \<in> G; y \<in> G; z \<in> G\<rbrakk> \<Longrightarrow> (x \<cdot> y) \<cdot> z = x \<cdot> (y \<cdot> z)"
    and unit_closed: "e \<in> G"
    and left_unit: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> e \<cdot> x = x"
    and inv_closed: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> ginv x \<in> G"
    and left_inv: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> ginv x \<cdot> x = e"

text \<open>Primality from first principles (\<open>Main\<close> has no notion of primes).\<close>

definition prime :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool" where
  "prime p \<longleftrightarrow> 1 < p \<and> (\<forall>d. d dvd p \<longrightarrow> d = 1 \<or> d = p)"

text \<open>Natural-number powers \<open>x\<^sup>n = x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> (\<dots> \<cdot> e))\<close>, and their name inside the locale.\<close>

primrec gpow :: "('a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a) \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> 'a \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "gpow m u x 0 = u"
| "gpow m u x (Suc n) = m x (gpow m u x n)"

abbreviation (in grp) pow :: "'a \<Rightarrow> nat \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "pow x n \<equiv> gpow mult e x n"

end
----
theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

theorem (in grp) cauchy:
  assumes "finite G" and "prime p" and "p dvd card G"
  shows "\<exists>x\<in>G. pow x p = e \<and> (\<forall>k. 0 < k \<longrightarrow> k < p \<longrightarrow> pow x k \<noteq> e)"
  sorry

end

import Mathlib.GroupTheory.Sylow

/-- Cauchy's theorem: if a prime `p` divides the order of a finite group, some element has
order `p`. -/
theorem cauchy (G : Type*) [Group G] [Fintype G] (p : ℕ) [hp : Fact p.Prime]
    (hdvd : p ∣ Fintype.card G) : ∃ x : G, orderOf x = p := by
  have hcard0 : Fintype.card G ≠ 0 := Fintype.card_ne_zero
  -- write |G| = p^e * m with p ∤ m
  obtain ⟨e, m, hm, hem⟩ := Nat.exists_eq_pow_mul_and_not_dvd hcard0 p hp.out.ne_one
  have he : e ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    simp only [pow_zero, one_mul] at hem
    exact hm (hem ▸ hdvd)
  -- a subgroup of order p^e
  have hpe : p ^ e ∣ Nat.card G := by
    rw [Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, hem]; exact Dvd.intro _ rfl
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := Sylow.exists_subgroup_card_pow_prime p hpe
  -- K is nontrivial, so it has an element x ≠ 1
  have hKnt : Nontrivial K := by
    rw [← Finite.one_lt_card_iff_nontrivial, hK]
    exact Nat.one_lt_pow he hp.out.one_lt
  obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := exists_ne (1 : K)
  -- its order is a power p^j of p, with j ≥ 1
  have hdiv : orderOf x ∣ p ^ e := hK ▸ orderOf_dvd_natCard x
  obtain ⟨j, hj, hxj⟩ := (Nat.dvd_prime_pow hp.out).mp hdiv
  have hj0 : j ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    exact hx (orderOf_eq_one_iff.mp (by simpa using hxj))
  -- y = x^(p^(j-1)) has order p
  have hpdvd : p ∣ orderOf x := by
    rw [hxj]; exact dvd_pow_self p hj0
  have hord : orderOf (x ^ (orderOf x / p)) = p :=
    orderOf_pow_orderOf_div (orderOf_pos x).ne' hpdvd
  refine ⟨((x ^ (orderOf x / p) : K) : G), ?_⟩
  rw [Subgroup.orderOf_coe, hord]

#print axioms cauchy

steps.message: Lemma names check out. I'll test the induction-naming and `funpow` idioms in a scratch theory before writing the full file.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/scratch && cd /tmp/scratch && cat > ROOT <<'EOF'
session Scratch = HOL +
  theories T
EOF
cat > T.thy <<'EOF'
theory T
  imports Main
begin

lemma gcd_closed_pred:
  fixes H :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes mod_mem: "\<And>m n. H m \<Longrightarrow> H n \<Longrightarrow> H (n mod m)"
  shows "H a \<Longrightarrow> H b \<Longrightarrow> H (gcd a b)"
proof (induction a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n)
  show ?case
  proof (intro impliesI)
    assume hm: "H m" and hn: "H n"
    have hr: "H (m mod n)" using mod_mem[OF hn hm] .
    have "H (gcd n (m mod n))" using step(2)[OF hn hr] .
    thus "H (gcd m n)" using gcd_non_0_nat[of n m] step(1) by simp
  qed
qed

lemma funpow_test: "(f ^^ Suc n) x = f ((f ^^ n) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_swap1)

lemma dvd_test: "p dvd c \<Longrightarrow> p dvd (c :: nat) ^ (p - 1)"
  by (metis dvd_power dvd_trans) 

end
EOF
time timeout 300 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /tmp/scratch 2>&1 | tail -40
arguments.description: Test induction and funpow idioms in scratch theory

steps.message: The build takes about 20s now, so I'll test the induction idioms in scratch before the full file.

arguments.command:
cd /tmp/scratch && cat > T.thy <<'EOF'
theory T
  imports Main
begin

lemma gcd_closed_pred:
  fixes H :: "nat \<Rightarrow> bool"
  assumes mod_mem: "\<And>m n. H m \<Longrightarrow> H n \<Longrightarrow> H (n mod m)"
  shows "H a \<Longrightarrow> H b \<Longrightarrow> H (gcd a b)"
proof (induction a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n)
  show ?case
  proof (rule impI)
    assume hm: "H m"
    show "H n \<Longrightarrow> H (gcd m n)"
    proof (rule impI)
      assume hn: "H n"
      have hr: "H (m mod n)" by (rule mod_mem[OF hn hm])
      have ih: "H (gcd n (m mod n))" using step.IH[OF hn hr] .
      show "H (gcd m n)"
      proof (cases "n = 0")
        case True then show ?thesis using hm by simp
      next
        case False
        then show ?thesis using ih gcd_non_0_nat[of n m] by simp
      qed
    qed
  qed
qed

lemma funpow_test: "(f ^^ Suc n) x = f ((f ^^ n) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_swap1)

end
EOF
timeout 200 isabelle build -o threads=2 -D /tmp/scratch > log.txt 2>&1; tail -20 log.txt

theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

section \<open>Arithmetic facts\<close>

lemma prime_gcd_one:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p"
  shows "gcd p d = 1"
proof -
  have "gcd p d dvd p" by simp
  with pp have one_or_p: "gcd p d = 1 \<or> gcd p d = p" unfolding prime_def by blast
  have "gcd p d \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume eq: "gcd p d = p"
    have "gcd p d dvd d" by simp
    with eq have "p dvd d" by simp
    hence "p \<le> d" using d0 by (rule dvd_imp_le)
    with dp show False by simp
  qed
  with one_or_p show ?thesis by blast
qed

section \<open>Iterates of a single map\<close>

lemma funpow_Suc_left: "(f ^^ Suc n) x = f ((f ^^ n) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right funpow_swap1)

lemma funpow_mult_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ (m * q)) x = x"
proof (induction q)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc q)
  have "(f ^^ (m * Suc q)) x = (f ^^ m) ((f ^^ (m * q)) x)"
    by (simp add: mult_Suc funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = x" using Suc.IH assms by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma funpow_mod_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x"
proof -
  have "n = n mod m + m * (n div m)" by (rule mod_mult_div_eq[symmetric])
  hence "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m + m * (n div m))) x" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) ((f ^^ (m * (n div m))) x)"
    by (simp add: funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x" using funpow_mult_fix[OF assms] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma funpow_mem:
  assumes "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and "u \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S"
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case using assms(2) by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  then show ?case using assms(1) by (auto simp: funpow_Suc_left)
qed

lemma funpow_inj_on:
  assumes "inj_on f S" and "f ` S \<subseteq> S"
  shows "inj_on (f ^^ i) S"
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  show ?case
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix u v
    assume hu: "u \<in> S" and hv: "v \<in> S" and eq: "(f ^^ Suc i) u = (f ^^ Suc i) v"
    have "f ((f ^^ i) u) = f ((f ^^ i) v)" using eq by (simp add: funpow_Suc_left)
    moreover have "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S" and "(f ^^ i) v \<in> S"
      using funpow_mem[OF assms(2) hu] funpow_mem[OF assms(2) hv] by simp_all
    ultimately have "(f ^^ i) u = (f ^^ i) v" using assms(1) by (rule inj_onD)
    with Suc.IH hu hv show "u = v" by (rule inj_onD)
  qed
qed

section \<open>The orbit counting lemma\<close>

text \<open>For a map @{term f} of order dividing the prime @{term p} on a finite set, the number of
  points is congruent to the number of fixed points modulo @{term p}.\<close>

lemma orbit_count:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat and S :: "'a set"
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "finite S \<Longrightarrow> f ` S \<subseteq> S \<Longrightarrow> inj_on f S \<Longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
    \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>k. card S = card {x \<in> S. f x = x} + p * k"
proof (induction S rule: finite_psubset_induct)
  case (psubset S)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume fS_fin: "finite S" and fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and inj: "inj_on f S"
      and root: "\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x"
    show "\<exists>k. card S = card {x \<in> S. f x = x} + p * k"
    proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x = x")
      case True
      have "{x \<in> S. f x = x} = S" using True by auto
      then show ?thesis by (intro exI[of _ 0]) simp
    next
      case False
      then obtain x where xS: "x \<in> S" and fx: "f x \<noteq> x" by blast
      have p_pos: "0 < p" using pp unfolding prime_def by simp
      obtain q where pq: "p = Suc q" using p_pos by (cases p) auto
      define O where "O = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}"
      have x_root: "(f ^^ p) x = x" using root xS by blast
      have orb_mem: "\<And>i. (f ^^ i) x \<in> S" using funpow_mem[OF fS xS] by blast
      have O_sub: "O \<subseteq> S" unfolding O_def using orb_mem by auto
      have fin_O: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
      have x_in_O: "x \<in> O" unfolding O_def using p_pos by force
      -- no fixed point other than x is reached by a short period
      have no_short: "\<And>d. 0 < d \<Longrightarrow> d < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ d) x \<noteq> x"
      proof
        fix d assume d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p" and dx: "(f ^^ d) x = x"
        have "(f ^^ gcd p d) x = x"
        proof -
          have "(f ^^ gcd p d) x = (f ^^ (gcd p d)) x" by simp
          have step1: "\<And>m n. (f ^^ m) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ n) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ (n mod m)) x = x"
            using funpow_mod_fix by metis
          show ?thesis
            sorry
        qed
        then have "(f ^^ 1) x = x" using prime_gcd_one[OF pp d0 dp] by simp
        then show False using fx by simp
      qed
      show ?thesis
        sorry
    qed
  qed
qed

end

section \<open>Arithmetic facts\<close>

lemma prime_gcd_one:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p"
  shows "gcd p d = 1"
proof -
  have "gcd p d dvd p" by simp
  with pp have one_or_p: "gcd p d = 1 \<or> gcd p d = p" unfolding prime_def by blast
  have "gcd p d \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume eq: "gcd p d = p"
    have "gcd p d dvd d" by simp
    with eq have "p dvd d" by simp
    hence "p \<le> d" using d0 by (rule dvd_imp_le)
    with dp show False by simp
  qed
  with one_or_p show ?thesis by blast
qed

section \<open>Iterates of a single map\<close>

lemma funpow_Suc_left: "(f ^^ Suc n) x = f ((f ^^ n) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right funpow_swap1)

lemma funpow_mult_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ (m * q)) x = x"
proof (induction q)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc q)
  have "(f ^^ (m * Suc q)) x = (f ^^ m) ((f ^^ (m * q)) x)"
    by (simp add: mult_Suc funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = x" using Suc.IH assms by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma funpow_mod_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x"
proof -
  have "n = n mod m + m * (n div m)" by (rule mod_mult_div_eq[symmetric])
  hence "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m + m * (n div m))) x" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) ((f ^^ (m * (n div m))) x)"
    by (simp add: funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x" using funpow_mult_fix[OF assms] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma funpow_mem:
  assumes "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and "u \<in> S"

proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case using assms(2) by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  then show ?case using assms(1) by (auto simp: funpow_Suc_left)
qed

lemma funpow_inj_on:
  assumes "inj_on f S" and "f ` S \<subseteq> S"

  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  show ?case
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix u v
    assume hu: "u \<in> S" and hv: "v \<in> S" and eq: "(f ^^ Suc i) u = (f ^^ Suc i) v"
    have "f ((f ^^ i) u) = f ((f ^^ i) v)" using eq by (simp add: funpow_Suc_left)
    moreover have "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S" and "(f ^^ i) v \<in> S"

    ultimately have "(f ^^ i) u = (f ^^ i) v" using assms(1) by (rule inj_onD)
    with Suc.IH hu hv show "u = v" by (rule inj_onD)
  qed
qed

arguments.content:
theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

section \<open>Arithmetic\<close>

lemma prime_gcd_one:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p"
  shows "gcd p d = 1"
proof -
  have "gcd p d dvd p" by simp
  with pp have one_or_p: "gcd p d = 1 \<or> gcd p d = p" unfolding prime_def by blast
  have "gcd p d \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume eq: "gcd p d = p"
    have "gcd p d dvd d" by simp
    with eq have "p dvd d" by simp
    hence "p \<le> d" using d0 by (rule dvd_imp_le)
    with dp show False by simp
  qed
  with one_or_p show ?thesis by blast
qed

section \<open>Iterates of one map\<close>

lemma funpow_Suc_left: "(f ^^ Suc n) x = f ((f ^^ n) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right funpow_swap1)

lemma funpow_mult_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ (m * q)) x = x"
proof (induction q)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc q)
  have "(f ^^ (m * Suc q)) x = (f ^^ m) ((f ^^ (m * q)) x)"
    by (simp add: mult_Suc funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = x" using Suc.IH assms by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma funpow_mod_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x"
proof -
  have "n = n mod m + m * (n div m)" by (rule mod_mult_div_eq[symmetric])
  hence "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m + m * (n div m))) x" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) ((f ^^ (m * (n div m))) x)"
    by (simp add: funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x" using funpow_mult_fix[OF assms] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma funpow_mem:
  assumes fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and uS: "u \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S"
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case using uS by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  then show ?case using fS by (auto simp: funpow_Suc_left)
qed

lemma funpow_inj_on:
  assumes inj: "inj_on f S" and fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S"
  shows "inj_on (f ^^ i) S"
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  show ?case
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix u v
    assume hu: "u \<in> S" and hv: "v \<in> S" and eq: "(f ^^ Suc i) u = (f ^^ Suc i) v"
    have "f ((f ^^ i) u) = f ((f ^^ i) v)" using eq by (simp add: funpow_Suc_left)
    moreover have "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S" and "(f ^^ i) v \<in> S"
      using funpow_mem[OF fS hu] funpow_mem[OF fS hv] by simp_all
    ultimately have "(f ^^ i) u = (f ^^ i) v" by (rule inj_onD[OF inj])
    thus "u = v" using Suc.IH hu hv by (rule inj_onD)
  qed
qed

lemma fixpt_pow:
  assumes fz: "f z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ n) z = z"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by (simp add: funpow_Suc_left fz)
qed

lemma gcd_fix_pt:
  "(f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) x = x"
proof (induction a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume hm: "(f ^^ m) x = x" and hn: "(f ^^ n) x = x"
    have hr: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x"
    proof -
      have "(f ^^ (m mod n)) x = (f ^^ m) x" using funpow_mod_fix[OF hn, of m] by simp
      thus ?thesis using hm by simp
    qed
    have ih: "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x" using step.IH[OF hn hr] .
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "n = 0")
      case True
      with hm show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)" using gcd_non_0_nat[of m n False] by simp
      with ih show ?thesis by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Orbit counting modulo a prime\<close>

text \<open>If a map @{term f} sends a finite set @{term S} into itself, injectively, and every point
  returns after exactly dividing @{term p} steps, then @{term "card S"} and the number of fixed
  points agree modulo @{term p}.\<close>

lemma orbit_count:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "finite S \<Longrightarrow> f ` S \<subseteq> S \<Longrightarrow> inj_on f S \<Longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
    \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>k. card S = card {x \<in> S. f x = x} + p * k"
proof (induction S rule: finite_psubset_induct)
  case (psubset S)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume fin: "finite S" and fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and inj: "inj_on f S"
      and root: "\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x"
    show "\<exists>k. card S = card {x \<in> S. f x = x} + p * k"
    proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x = x")
      case True
      have "{x \<in> S. f x = x} = S" using True by auto
      then show ?thesis by (intro exI[of _ 0]) simp
    next
      case False
      then obtain x where xS: "x \<in> S" and fx: "f x \<noteq> x" by blast
      have p_gt1: "1 < p" using pp unfolding prime_def by simp
      have p_pos: "0 < p" using p_gt1 by simp
      obtain q where pq: "p = Suc q" using p_pos by (cases p) auto
      have x_root: "(f ^^ p) x = x" using root xS by blast
      define O where "O = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}"
      have orb_mem: "\<And>i. (f ^^ i) x \<in> S" using funpow_mem[OF fS xS] by blast
      have O_sub: "O \<subseteq> S" unfolding O_def using orb_mem by auto
      have fin_O: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
      have x_in_O: "x \<in> O"
        unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[of _ _ 0]) (simp_all add: p_pos)
      -- a point of period strictly less than p, other than x itself, cannot exist
      have no_short: "\<And>d. 0 < d \<Longrightarrow> d < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ d) x \<noteq> x"
      proof
        fix d assume d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p" and dx: "(f ^^ d) x = x"
        have "(f ^^ gcd p d) x = x" using gcd_fix_pt[OF x_root dx] .
        hence "(f ^^ 1) x = x" using prime_gcd_one[OF pp d0 dp] by simp
        thus False using fx by simp
      qed
      -- the orbit of x has exactly p distinct points
      have inj_idx: "\<And>i j. i < j \<Longrightarrow> j < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
      proof
        fix i j assume ij: "i < j" and jp: "j < p" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
        have split: "(f ^^ j) x = (f ^^ i) ((f ^^ (j - i)) x)"
        proof -
          have "(f ^^ j) x = (f ^^ (i + (j - i))) x" using ij by (simp add: less_imp_le)
          also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i) ((f ^^ (j - i)) x)" by (simp add: funpow_add)
          finally show ?thesis .
        qed
        have dmem: "(f ^^ (j - i)) x \<in> S" using orb_mem by blast
        have dx: "(f ^^ i) ((f ^^ (j - i)) x) = (f ^^ i) x" using eq split by simp
        have "(f ^^ (j - i)) x = x"
          by (rule inj_onD[OF funpow_inj_on[OF inj fS, of i] dx dmem xS])
        moreover have "0 < j - i" and "j - i < p" using ij jp by simp_all
        ultimately show False using no_short by blast
      qed
      have inj_O: "inj_on (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) {..<p}"
      proof (rule inj_onI)
        fix i j
        assume hi: "i \<in> {..<p}" and hj: "j \<in> {..<p}" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
        show "i = j"
        proof (rule ccontr)
          assume neq: "i \<noteq> j"
          hence "i < j \<or> j < i" by auto
          thus False
          proof
            assume "i < j"
            moreover have "j < p" using hj by simp
            ultimately show False using inj_idx eq by blast
          next
            assume "j < i"
            moreover have "i < p" using hi by simp
            ultimately show False using inj_idx eq by blast
          qed
        qed
      qed
      have card_O: "card O = p" unfolding O_def using inj_O by (simp add: card_image)
      have cardS: "card O \<le> card S" using card_mono[OF fin O_sub] .
      -- the complement of the orbit
      define S' where "S' = S - O"
      have S'_sub: "S' \<subseteq> S" unfolding S'_def by auto
      have fin': "finite S'" using fin S'_sub by (rule finite_subset)
      have x_not_S': "x \<notin> S'" unfolding S'_def using x_in_O by auto
      have S'_psub: "S' \<subset> S" using S'_sub x_not_S' xS by blast
      have fS': "f ` S' \<subseteq> S'"
      proof (rule image_subsetI)
        fix y assume yS': "y \<in> S'"
        hence yS: "y \<in> S" and yO: "y \<notin> O" unfolding S'_def by auto
        have fyS: "f y \<in> S" using fS yS by blast
        have fyO: "f y \<notin> O"
        proof
          assume fyO: "f y \<in> O"
          then obtain i where hi: "i < p" and fy: "f y = (f ^^ i) x"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          have cases_i: "i = 0 \<or> (\<exists>k. i = Suc k)" by (cases i) auto
          then show False
          proof
            assume i0: "i = 0"
            have fy0: "f y = x" using fy i0 by simp
            have "(f ^^ p) y = y" using root yS by blast
            moreover have "(f ^^ p) y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" using pq by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right)
            ultimately have "y = (f ^^ q) x" using fy0 by simp
            hence "y \<in> O" unfolding O_def using pq by auto
            with yO show False by blast
          next
            assume "\<exists>k. i = Suc k"
            then obtain k where ik: "i = Suc k" by blast
            have fk: "f ((f ^^ k) x) = f y" using fy ik by simp
            have "(f ^^ k) x \<in> S" using orb_mem by blast
            hence "(f ^^ k) x = y" using inj yS fk by (rule inj_onD[OF inj, of _ y])
            hence "y \<in> O" unfolding O_def using ik hi by auto
            with yO show False by blast
          qed
        qed
        show "f y \<in> S'" unfolding S'_def using fyS fyO by simp
      qed
      have inj': "inj_on f S'" using inj S'_sub by (rule inj_on_subset)
      have root': "\<forall>y\<in>S'. (f ^^ p) y = y" using root S'_sub by blast
      -- fixed points are not in the orbit
      have fixO: "\<And>z. z \<in> O \<Longrightarrow> f z = z \<Longrightarrow> False"
      proof -
        fix z assume zO: "z \<in> O" and fz: "f z = z"
        then obtain i where hi: "i < p" and zi: "z = (f ^^ i) x" unfolding O_def by auto
        have key: "(f ^^ (p - i + i)) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)" by (simp add: funpow_add)
        have "p - i + i = p" using hi by simp
        hence "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) z" using key zi by simp
        hence "x = z" using x_root fixpt_pow[OF fz, of "p - i"] by simp
        hence "f x = x" using fz by simp
        thus False using fx by contradiction
      qed
      have fix_eq: "{z \<in> S. f z = z} = {z \<in> S'. f z = z}"
      proof
        show "{z \<in> S. f z = z} \<subseteq> {z \<in> S'. f z = z}"
        proof
          fix z assume "z \<in> {z \<in> S. f z = z}"
          hence zS: "z \<in> S" and fz: "f z = z" by auto
          have "z \<notin> O" using fixO fz by blast
          thus "z \<in> {z \<in> S'. f z = z}" unfolding S'_def using zS fz by simp
        qed
      next
        show "{z \<in> S'. f z = z} \<subseteq> {z \<in> S. f z = z}" using S'_sub by auto
      qed
      have fixcard: "card {z \<in> S. f z = z} = card {z \<in> S'. f z = z}" using fix_eq by simp
      have IH: "\<exists>k. card S' = card {z \<in> S'. f z = z} + p * k"
        using psubset.IH[OF S'_psub fin' fS' inj' root'] .
      obtain k where kS: "card S' = card {z \<in> S'. f z = z} + p * k" using IH by blast
      have cardS_eq: "card S = card S' + p"
        unfolding S'_def using card_Diff_subset[OF fin_O O_sub] card_O cardS by linarith
      have "card S = card {z \<in> S. f z = z} + p * Suc k"
        using kS cardS_eq fixcard by (simp only: mult_Suc) linarith
      thus ?thesis by blast
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Group facts from the basic axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma idem_is_e:
  assumes tG: "t \<in> G" and tt: "t \<cdot> t = t"
  shows "t = e"
proof -
  have vG: "ginv t \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF tG])
  have "t = e \<cdot> t" using left_unit[OF tG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv t \<cdot> t) \<cdot> t" using left_inv[OF tG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = ginv t \<cdot> (t \<cdot> t)" by (rule assoc[OF vG tG tG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv t \<cdot> t" using tt by simp
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule left_inv[OF tG])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma right_inv:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  have uG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have tG: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF xG uG])
  have tt: "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> ginv x"
  proof -
    have "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
      by (rule assoc[OF xG uG tG])
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> ((ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x)"
      using assoc[OF uG xG uG] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> (e \<cdot> ginv x)" using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> ginv x" using left_unit[OF uG] by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis by (rule idem_is_e[OF tG tt])
qed

lemma right_unit:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  have uG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF xG uG xG])
  also have "\<dots> = x" using right_inv[OF xG] left_unit[OF xG] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma left_cancel:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and yG: "y \<in> G" and zG: "z \<in> G" and eq: "x \<cdot> y = x \<cdot> z"
  shows "y = z"
proof -
  have uG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have "y = e \<cdot> y" using left_unit[OF yG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> y" using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> y)" by (rule assoc[OF uG xG yG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> z)" using eq by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> z" by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF uG xG zG])
  also have "\<dots> = z" using left_inv[OF xG] left_unit[OF zG] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma comm_inv:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and yG: "y \<in> G" and eq: "x \<cdot> y = e"
  shows "y \<cdot> x = e"
proof -
  have "y = ginv x"
    by (rule left_cancel[OF xG yG inv_closed[OF xG]]) (simp add: eq right_inv[OF xG])
  thus ?thesis using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
qed

subsection \<open>Powers\<close>

lemma pow_closed:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x n \<in> G"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case using unit_closed by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case using closed[OF xG Suc.IH] by simp
qed

lemma pow_add:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x (m + n) = pow x m \<cdot> pow x n"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  then show ?case using left_unit[OF pow_closed[OF xG, of n]] by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  have "pow x (Suc m + n) = x \<cdot> pow x (m + n)" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> (pow x m \<cdot> pow x n)" using Suc.IH by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> pow x m) \<cdot> pow x n"
    by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF xG pow_closed[OF xG] pow_closed[OF xG]])
  also have "\<dots> = pow x (Suc m) \<cdot> pow x n" by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma pow_one:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x 1 = x"
  using right_unit[OF xG] by simp

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case using left_unit[OF unit_closed] by simp
qed

lemma pow_mult_e:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and me: "pow x m = e"
  shows "pow x (m * q) = e"
proof (induction q)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc q)
  have "pow x (m * Suc q) = pow x m \<cdot> pow x (m * q)"
    by (simp add: mult_Suc pow_add[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = e" using me Suc.IH by (simp add: left_unit[OF unit_closed])
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma pow_mod:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and me: "pow x m = e"
  shows "pow x n = pow x (n mod m)"
proof -
  have "pow x n = pow x (n mod m + m * (n div m))" by (simp add: mod_mult_div_eq)
  also have "\<dots> = pow x (n mod m) \<cdot> pow x (m * (n div m))" by (rule pow_add[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = pow x (n mod m)"
    using pow_mult_e[OF xG me] right_unit[OF pow_closed[OF xG, of "n mod m"]] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma pow_gcd:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x a = e \<Longrightarrow> pow x b = e \<Longrightarrow> pow x (gcd a b) = e"
proof (induction a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume hm: "pow x m = e" and hn: "pow x n = e"
    have hr: "pow x (m mod n) = e" by (rule trans[OF sym[OF pow_mod[OF xG hn, of m]] hm])
    have ih: "pow x (gcd n (m mod n)) = e" using step.IH[OF hn hr] .
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "n = 0")
      case True
      with hm show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)" using gcd_non_0_nat[of m n False] by simp
      with ih show ?thesis by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

subsection \<open>Finite lists of group elements\<close>

primrec lprod :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "lprod [] = e"
| "lprod (y # ys) = y \<cdot> lprod ys"

abbreviation SS :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "SS p \<equiv> {xs. set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> length xs = p \<and> lprod xs = e}"

lemma lprod_closed: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> lprod xs \<in> G"
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case using unit_closed by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume h: "set (a # xs) \<subseteq> G"
    hence aG: "a \<in> G" and xsG: "set xs \<subseteq> G" by auto
    have "lprod xs \<in> G" using Cons.IH[OF xsG] .
    thus ?thesis using closed[OF aG this] by simp
  qed
qed

lemma lprod_snoc: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> lprod (xs @ [y]) = lprod xs \<cdot> y"
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case using right_unit[OF _] left_unit by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume h: "set (a # xs) \<subseteq> G" and yG: "y \<in> G"
    hence aG: "a \<in> G" and xsG: "set xs \<subseteq> G" by auto
    have "lprod ((a # xs) @ [y]) = a \<cdot> (lprod xs \<cdot> y)" using Cons.IH[OF xsG yG] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = (a \<cdot> lprod xs) \<cdot> y"
      by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF aG lprod_closed[OF xsG] yG])
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
qed

lemma lprod_replicate: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> lprod (replicate n x) = pow x n"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by simp
qed

end

section \<open>Rotation of tuples\<close>

primrec rot :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "rot [] = []"
| "rot (y # ys) = ys @ [y]"

lemma rot_inj: "length xs = length ys \<Longrightarrow> rot xs = rot ys \<Longrightarrow> xs = ys"
proof (induction xs arbitrary: ys)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a as)
  then obtain b bs where ys: "ys = b # bs" by (cases ys) auto
  from Cons.prems ys have "as @ [a] = bs @ [b]" by simp
  moreover have "length as = length bs" using Cons.prems(1) ys by simp
  ultimately have "as = bs" and "[a] = [b]" by (rule append_inj)+
  thus ?case using ys by simp
qed

lemma rot_iter: "(rot ^^ length a) (a @ b) = b @ a"
proof (induction a arbitrary: b)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons y a)
  have "(rot ^^ length (y # a)) ((y # a) @ b) = (rot ^^ length a) (rot (y # (a @ b)))"
    by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right)
  also have "\<dots> = (rot ^^ length a) (a @ (b @ [y]))" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (b @ [y]) @ a" using Cons.IH by simp
  also have "\<dots> = b @ (y # a)" by simp
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

lemma rot_pow: "(rot ^^ length xs) xs = xs"
  using rot_iter[of xs "[]"] by simp

lemma rot_replicate: "rot (replicate n y) = replicate n y"
proof (cases n)
  case 0
  then show ?thesis by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  have "rot (replicate (Suc m) y) = replicate m y @ [y]" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = replicate (Suc m) y" by (rule replicate_append_same)
  finally show ?thesis using Suc by simp
qed

lemma cyc_fixed: "as @ [y] = y # as \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>n. as = replicate n y"
proof (induction as)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (intro exI[of _ 0]) simp
next
  case (Cons a bs)
  have h: "a = y \<and> bs @ [y] = a # bs" using Cons.prems by simp
  hence ay: "a = y" and bsy: "bs @ [y] = y # bs" by auto
  obtain n where bn: "bs = replicate n y" using Cons.IH[OF bsy] by blast
  show ?case using ay bn by (intro exI[of _ "Suc n"]) simp
qed

lemma rot_fixed:
  assumes "rot xs = xs" and "xs \<noteq> []"
  shows "\<exists>y. xs = replicate (length xs) y"
proof (cases xs)
  case Nil
  with assms(2) show ?thesis by simp
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have "ys @ [y] = y # ys" using assms(1) Cons by simp
  then obtain n where "ys = replicate n y" using cyc_fixed by blast
  thus ?thesis using Cons by (intro exI[of _ y]) simp
qed

context grp
begin

lemma rot_mem:
  assumes xs: "xs \<in> SS p" and p0: "0 < p"
  shows "rot xs \<in> SS p"
proof -
  from xs have sub: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e" by auto
  from len p0 obtain y ys where xs': "xs = y # ys" by (cases xs) auto
  from sub xs' have yG: "y \<in> G" and ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" by auto
  have P: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_closed[OF ysG])
  have yP: "y \<cdot> lprod ys = e" using ev xs' by simp
  have Py: "lprod ys \<cdot> y = e" by (rule comm_inv[OF yG P yP])
  have rot_eq: "rot xs = ys @ [y]" using xs' by simp
  have "lprod (ys @ [y]) = e" using lprod_snoc[OF ysG yG] Py by simp
  moreover have "set (ys @ [y]) \<subseteq> G" using ysG yG by auto
  moreover have "length (ys @ [y]) = p" using len xs' by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis unfolding rot_eq by simp
qed

end

section \<open>Counting the tuples\<close>

lemma card_SS_eq:
  assumes fin: "finite G" and p0: "0 < p"
  shows "card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
  sorry

end

theory Cauchy
  imports Group_Axioms
begin

section \<open>Arithmetic\<close>

lemma prime_gcd_one:
  assumes pp: "prime p" and d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p"
  shows "gcd p d = 1"
proof -
  have "gcd p d dvd p" by simp
  with pp have one_or_p: "gcd p d = 1 \<or> gcd p d = p" unfolding prime_def by blast
  have "gcd p d \<noteq> p"
  proof
    assume eq: "gcd p d = p"
    have "gcd p d dvd d" by simp
    with eq have "p dvd d" by simp
    hence "p \<le> d" using d0 by (rule dvd_imp_le)
    with dp show False by simp
  qed
  with one_or_p show ?thesis by blast
qed

section \<open>Iterates of one map\<close>

lemma funpow_Suc_left: "(f ^^ Suc n) x = f ((f ^^ n) x)"
  by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right funpow_swap1)

lemma funpow_mult_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ (m * q)) x = x"
proof (induction q)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc q)
  have "(f ^^ (m * Suc q)) x = (f ^^ m) ((f ^^ (m * q)) x)"
    by (simp add: mult_Suc funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = x" using Suc.IH assms by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma funpow_mod_fix:
  assumes "(f ^^ m) x = x"
  shows "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x"
proof -
  have "n = n mod m + m * (n div m)" by (rule mod_mult_div_eq[symmetric])
  hence "(f ^^ n) x = (f ^^ (n mod m + m * (n div m))) x" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) ((f ^^ (m * (n div m))) x)"
    by (simp add: funpow_add)
  also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ (n mod m)) x" using funpow_mult_fix[OF assms] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma funpow_mem:
  assumes fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and uS: "u \<in> S"
  shows "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S"
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case using uS by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  then show ?case using fS by (auto simp: funpow_Suc_left)
qed

lemma funpow_inj_on:
  assumes inj: "inj_on f S" and fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S"
  shows "inj_on (f ^^ i) S"
proof (induction i)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc i)
  show ?case
  proof (rule inj_onI)
    fix u v
    assume hu: "u \<in> S" and hv: "v \<in> S" and eq: "(f ^^ Suc i) u = (f ^^ Suc i) v"
    have "f ((f ^^ i) u) = f ((f ^^ i) v)" using eq by (simp add: funpow_Suc_left)
    moreover have "(f ^^ i) u \<in> S" and "(f ^^ i) v \<in> S"
      using funpow_mem[OF fS hu] funpow_mem[OF fS hv] by simp_all
    ultimately have "(f ^^ i) u = (f ^^ i) v" by (rule inj_onD[OF inj])
    thus "u = v" using Suc.IH hu hv by (rule inj_onD)
  qed
qed

lemma fixpt_pow:
  assumes fz: "f z = z"
  shows "(f ^^ n) z = z"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by (simp add: funpow_Suc_left fz)
qed

lemma gcd_fix_pt:
  "(f ^^ a) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ b) x = x \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ gcd a b) x = x"
proof (induction a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume hm: "(f ^^ m) x = x" and hn: "(f ^^ n) x = x"
    have hr: "(f ^^ (m mod n)) x = x"
    proof -
      have "(f ^^ (m mod n)) x = (f ^^ m) x" using funpow_mod_fix[OF hn, of m] by simp
      thus ?thesis using hm by simp
    qed
    have ih: "(f ^^ gcd n (m mod n)) x = x" using step.IH[OF hn hr] .
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "n = 0")
      case True
      with hm show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)" using gcd_non_0_nat[of m n False] by simp
      with ih show ?thesis by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Orbit counting modulo a prime\<close>

text \<open>If a map @{term f} sends a finite set @{term S} into itself, injectively, and every point
  returns after exactly dividing @{term p} steps, then @{term "card S"} and the number of fixed
  points agree modulo @{term p}.\<close>

lemma orbit_count:
  fixes f :: "'a \<Rightarrow> 'a" and p :: nat
  assumes pp: "prime p"
  shows "finite S \<Longrightarrow> f ` S \<subseteq> S \<Longrightarrow> inj_on f S \<Longrightarrow> (\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x)
    \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>k. card S = card {x \<in> S. f x = x} + p * k"
proof (induction S rule: finite_psubset_induct)
  case (psubset S)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume fin: "finite S" and fS: "f ` S \<subseteq> S" and inj: "inj_on f S"
      and root: "\<forall>x\<in>S. (f ^^ p) x = x"
    show "\<exists>k. card S = card {x \<in> S. f x = x} + p * k"
    proof (cases "\<forall>x\<in>S. f x = x")
      case True
      have "{x \<in> S. f x = x} = S" using True by auto
      then show ?thesis by (intro exI[of _ 0]) simp
    next
      case False
      then obtain x where xS: "x \<in> S" and fx: "f x \<noteq> x" by blast
      have p_gt1: "1 < p" using pp unfolding prime_def by simp
      have p_pos: "0 < p" using p_gt1 by simp
      obtain q where pq: "p = Suc q" using p_pos by (cases p) auto
      have x_root: "(f ^^ p) x = x" using root xS by blast
      define O where "O = (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) ` {..<p}"
      have orb_mem: "\<And>i. (f ^^ i) x \<in> S" using funpow_mem[OF fS xS] by blast
      have O_sub: "O \<subseteq> S" unfolding O_def using orb_mem by auto
      have fin_O: "finite O" unfolding O_def by simp
      have x_in_O: "x \<in> O"
        unfolding O_def by (rule image_eqI[of _ _ 0]) (simp_all add: p_pos)
      -- a point of period strictly less than p, other than x itself, cannot exist
      have no_short: "\<And>d. 0 < d \<Longrightarrow> d < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ d) x \<noteq> x"
      proof
        fix d assume d0: "0 < d" and dp: "d < p" and dx: "(f ^^ d) x = x"
        have "(f ^^ gcd p d) x = x" using gcd_fix_pt[OF x_root dx] .
        hence "(f ^^ 1) x = x" using prime_gcd_one[OF pp d0 dp] by simp
        thus False using fx by simp
      qed
      -- the orbit of x has exactly p distinct points
      have inj_idx: "\<And>i j. i < j \<Longrightarrow> j < p \<Longrightarrow> (f ^^ i) x \<noteq> (f ^^ j) x"
      proof
        fix i j assume ij: "i < j" and jp: "j < p" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
        have split: "(f ^^ j) x = (f ^^ i) ((f ^^ (j - i)) x)"
        proof -
          have "(f ^^ j) x = (f ^^ (i + (j - i))) x" using ij by (simp add: less_imp_le)
          also have "\<dots> = (f ^^ i) ((f ^^ (j - i)) x)" by (simp add: funpow_add)
          finally show ?thesis .
        qed
        have dmem: "(f ^^ (j - i)) x \<in> S" using orb_mem by blast
        have dx: "(f ^^ i) ((f ^^ (j - i)) x) = (f ^^ i) x" using eq split by simp
        have "(f ^^ (j - i)) x = x"
          by (rule inj_onD[OF funpow_inj_on[OF inj fS, of i] dx dmem xS])
        moreover have "0 < j - i" and "j - i < p" using ij jp by simp_all
        ultimately show False using no_short by blast
      qed
      have inj_O: "inj_on (\<lambda>i. (f ^^ i) x) {..<p}"
      proof (rule inj_onI)
        fix i j
        assume hi: "i \<in> {..<p}" and hj: "j \<in> {..<p}" and eq: "(f ^^ i) x = (f ^^ j) x"
        show "i = j"
        proof (rule ccontr)
          assume neq: "i \<noteq> j"
          hence "i < j \<or> j < i" by auto
          thus False
          proof
            assume "i < j"
            moreover have "j < p" using hj by simp
            ultimately show False using inj_idx eq by blast
          next
            assume "j < i"
            moreover have "i < p" using hi by simp
            ultimately show False using inj_idx eq by blast
          qed
        qed
      qed
      have card_O: "card O = p" unfolding O_def using inj_O by (simp add: card_image)
      have cardS: "card O \<le> card S" using card_mono[OF fin O_sub] .
      -- the complement of the orbit
      define S' where "S' = S - O"
      have S'_sub: "S' \<subseteq> S" unfolding S'_def by auto
      have fin': "finite S'" using fin S'_sub by (rule finite_subset)
      have x_not_S': "x \<notin> S'" unfolding S'_def using x_in_O by auto
      have S'_psub: "S' \<subset> S" using S'_sub x_not_S' xS by blast
      have fS': "f ` S' \<subseteq> S'"
      proof (rule image_subsetI)
        fix y assume yS': "y \<in> S'"
        hence yS: "y \<in> S" and yO: "y \<notin> O" unfolding S'_def by auto
        have fyS: "f y \<in> S" using fS yS by blast
        have fyO: "f y \<notin> O"
        proof
          assume fyO: "f y \<in> O"
          then obtain i where hi: "i < p" and fy: "f y = (f ^^ i) x"
            unfolding O_def by auto
          have cases_i: "i = 0 \<or> (\<exists>k. i = Suc k)" by (cases i) auto
          then show False
          proof
            assume i0: "i = 0"
            have fy0: "f y = x" using fy i0 by simp
            have "(f ^^ p) y = y" using root yS by blast
            moreover have "(f ^^ p) y = (f ^^ q) (f y)" using pq by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right)
            ultimately have "y = (f ^^ q) x" using fy0 by simp
            hence "y \<in> O" unfolding O_def using pq by auto
            with yO show False by blast
          next
            assume "\<exists>k. i = Suc k"
            then obtain k where ik: "i = Suc k" by blast
            have fk: "f ((f ^^ k) x) = f y" using fy ik by simp
            have "(f ^^ k) x \<in> S" using orb_mem by blast
            hence "(f ^^ k) x = y" using inj yS fk by (rule inj_onD[OF inj, of _ y])
            hence "y \<in> O" unfolding O_def using ik hi by auto
            with yO show False by blast
          qed
        qed
        show "f y \<in> S'" unfolding S'_def using fyS fyO by simp
      qed
      have inj': "inj_on f S'" using inj S'_sub by (rule inj_on_subset)
      have root': "\<forall>y\<in>S'. (f ^^ p) y = y" using root S'_sub by blast
      -- fixed points are not in the orbit
      have fixO: "\<And>z. z \<in> O \<Longrightarrow> f z = z \<Longrightarrow> False"
      proof -
        fix z assume zO: "z \<in> O" and fz: "f z = z"
        then obtain i where hi: "i < p" and zi: "z = (f ^^ i) x" unfolding O_def by auto
        have key: "(f ^^ (p - i + i)) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) ((f ^^ i) x)" by (simp add: funpow_add)
        have "p - i + i = p" using hi by simp
        hence "(f ^^ p) x = (f ^^ (p - i)) z" using key zi by simp
        hence "x = z" using x_root fixpt_pow[OF fz, of "p - i"] by simp
        hence "f x = x" using fz by simp
        thus False using fx by contradiction
      qed
      have fix_eq: "{z \<in> S. f z = z} = {z \<in> S'. f z = z}"
      proof
        show "{z \<in> S. f z = z} \<subseteq> {z \<in> S'. f z = z}"
        proof
          fix z assume "z \<in> {z \<in> S. f z = z}"
          hence zS: "z \<in> S" and fz: "f z = z" by auto
          have "z \<notin> O" using fixO fz by blast
          thus "z \<in> {z \<in> S'. f z = z}" unfolding S'_def using zS fz by simp
        qed
      next
        show "{z \<in> S'. f z = z} \<subseteq> {z \<in> S. f z = z}" using S'_sub by auto
      qed
      have fixcard: "card {z \<in> S. f z = z} = card {z \<in> S'. f z = z}" using fix_eq by simp
      have IH: "\<exists>k. card S' = card {z \<in> S'. f z = z} + p * k"
        using psubset.IH[OF S'_psub fin' fS' inj' root'] .
      obtain k where kS: "card S' = card {z \<in> S'. f z = z} + p * k" using IH by blast
      have cardS_eq: "card S = card S' + p"
        unfolding S'_def using card_Diff_subset[OF fin_O O_sub] card_O cardS by linarith
      have "card S = card {z \<in> S. f z = z} + p * Suc k"
        using kS cardS_eq fixcard by (simp only: mult_Suc) linarith
      thus ?thesis by blast
    qed
  qed
qed

section \<open>Group facts from the basic axioms\<close>

context grp
begin

lemma idem_is_e:
  assumes tG: "t \<in> G" and tt: "t \<cdot> t = t"
  shows "t = e"
proof -
  have vG: "ginv t \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF tG])
  have "t = e \<cdot> t" using left_unit[OF tG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv t \<cdot> t) \<cdot> t" using left_inv[OF tG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = ginv t \<cdot> (t \<cdot> t)" by (rule assoc[OF vG tG tG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv t \<cdot> t" using tt by simp
  also have "\<dots> = e" by (rule left_inv[OF tG])
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma right_inv:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> ginv x = e"
proof -
  have uG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have tG: "x \<cdot> ginv x \<in> G" by (rule closed[OF xG uG])
  have tt: "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> ginv x"
  proof -
    have "(x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x) = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> ginv x))"
      by (rule assoc[OF xG uG tG])
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> ((ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> ginv x)"
      using assoc[OF uG xG uG] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> (e \<cdot> ginv x)" using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> ginv x" using left_unit[OF uG] by simp
    finally show ?thesis .
  qed
  show ?thesis by (rule idem_is_e[OF tG tt])
qed

lemma right_unit:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "x \<cdot> e = x"
proof -
  have uG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have "x \<cdot> e = x \<cdot> (ginv x \<cdot> x)" using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> ginv x) \<cdot> x" by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF xG uG xG])
  also have "\<dots> = x" using right_inv[OF xG] left_unit[OF xG] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma left_cancel:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and yG: "y \<in> G" and zG: "z \<in> G" and eq: "x \<cdot> y = x \<cdot> z"
  shows "y = z"
proof -
  have uG: "ginv x \<in> G" by (rule inv_closed[OF xG])
  have "y = e \<cdot> y" using left_unit[OF yG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> y" using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
  also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> y)" by (rule assoc[OF uG xG yG])
  also have "\<dots> = ginv x \<cdot> (x \<cdot> z)" using eq by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (ginv x \<cdot> x) \<cdot> z" by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF uG xG zG])
  also have "\<dots> = z" using left_inv[OF xG] left_unit[OF zG] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma comm_inv:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and yG: "y \<in> G" and eq: "x \<cdot> y = e"
  shows "y \<cdot> x = e"
proof -
  have "y = ginv x"
    by (rule left_cancel[OF xG yG inv_closed[OF xG]]) (simp add: eq right_inv[OF xG])
  thus ?thesis using left_inv[OF xG] by simp
qed

subsection \<open>Powers\<close>

lemma pow_closed:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x n \<in> G"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case using unit_closed by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case using closed[OF xG Suc.IH] by simp
qed

lemma pow_add:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x (m + n) = pow x m \<cdot> pow x n"
proof (induction m)
  case 0
  then show ?case using left_unit[OF pow_closed[OF xG, of n]] by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  have "pow x (Suc m + n) = x \<cdot> pow x (m + n)" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = x \<cdot> (pow x m \<cdot> pow x n)" using Suc.IH by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (x \<cdot> pow x m) \<cdot> pow x n"
    by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF xG pow_closed[OF xG] pow_closed[OF xG]])
  also have "\<dots> = pow x (Suc m) \<cdot> pow x n" by simp
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma pow_one:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x 1 = x"
  using right_unit[OF xG] by simp

lemma pow_e: "pow e n = e"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case using left_unit[OF unit_closed] by simp
qed

lemma pow_mult_e:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and me: "pow x m = e"
  shows "pow x (m * q) = e"
proof (induction q)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc q)
  have "pow x (m * Suc q) = pow x m \<cdot> pow x (m * q)"
    by (simp add: mult_Suc pow_add[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = e" using me Suc.IH by (simp add: left_unit[OF unit_closed])
  finally show ?case .
qed

lemma pow_mod:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G" and me: "pow x m = e"
  shows "pow x n = pow x (n mod m)"
proof -
  have "pow x n = pow x (n mod m + m * (n div m))" by (simp add: mod_mult_div_eq)
  also have "\<dots> = pow x (n mod m) \<cdot> pow x (m * (n div m))" by (rule pow_add[OF xG])
  also have "\<dots> = pow x (n mod m)"
    using pow_mult_e[OF xG me] right_unit[OF pow_closed[OF xG, of "n mod m"]] by simp
  finally show ?thesis .
qed

lemma pow_gcd:
  assumes xG: "x \<in> G"
  shows "pow x a = e \<Longrightarrow> pow x b = e \<Longrightarrow> pow x (gcd a b) = e"
proof (induction a b rule: gcd_nat_induct)
  case (base m)
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (step m n)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume hm: "pow x m = e" and hn: "pow x n = e"
    have hr: "pow x (m mod n) = e" by (rule trans[OF sym[OF pow_mod[OF xG hn, of m]] hm])
    have ih: "pow x (gcd n (m mod n)) = e" using step.IH[OF hn hr] .
    show ?thesis
    proof (cases "n = 0")
      case True
      with hm show ?thesis by simp
    next
      case False
      have "gcd m n = gcd n (m mod n)" using gcd_non_0_nat[of m n False] by simp
      with ih show ?thesis by simp
    qed
  qed
qed

subsection \<open>Finite lists of group elements\<close>

primrec lprod :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a" where
  "lprod [] = e"
| "lprod (y # ys) = y \<cdot> lprod ys"

abbreviation SS :: "nat \<Rightarrow> 'a list set" where
  "SS p \<equiv> {xs. set xs \<subseteq> G \<and> length xs = p \<and> lprod xs = e}"

lemma lprod_closed: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> lprod xs \<in> G"
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case using unit_closed by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume h: "set (a # xs) \<subseteq> G"
    hence aG: "a \<in> G" and xsG: "set xs \<subseteq> G" by auto
    have "lprod xs \<in> G" using Cons.IH[OF xsG] .
    thus ?thesis using closed[OF aG this] by simp
  qed
qed

lemma lprod_snoc: "set xs \<subseteq> G \<Longrightarrow> y \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> lprod (xs @ [y]) = lprod xs \<cdot> y"
proof (induction xs)
  case Nil
  then show ?case using right_unit[OF _] left_unit by simp
next
  case (Cons a xs)
  show ?case
  proof -
    assume h: "set (a # xs) \<subseteq> G" and yG: "y \<in> G"
    hence aG: "a \<in> G" and xsG: "set xs \<subseteq> G" by auto
    have "lprod ((a # xs) @ [y]) = a \<cdot> (lprod xs \<cdot> y)" using Cons.IH[OF xsG yG] by simp
    also have "\<dots> = (a \<cdot> lprod xs) \<cdot> y"
      by (rule assoc[symmetric, OF aG lprod_closed[OF xsG] yG])
    finally show ?thesis by simp
  qed
qed

lemma lprod_replicate: "x \<in> G \<Longrightarrow> lprod (replicate n x) = pow x n"
proof (induction n)
  case 0
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Suc n)
  then show ?case by simp
qed

end

section \<open>Rotation of tuples\<close>

primrec rot :: "'a list \<Rightarrow> 'a list" where
  "rot [] = []"
| "rot (y # ys) = ys @ [y]"

lemma rot_inj: "length xs = length ys \<Longrightarrow> rot xs = rot ys \<Longrightarrow> xs = ys"
proof (induction xs arbitrary: ys)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons a as)
  then obtain b bs where ys: "ys = b # bs" by (cases ys) auto
  from Cons.prems ys have "as @ [a] = bs @ [b]" by simp
  moreover have "length as = length bs" using Cons.prems(1) ys by simp
  ultimately have "as = bs" and "[a] = [b]" by (rule append_inj)+
  thus ?case using ys by simp
qed

lemma rot_iter: "(rot ^^ length a) (a @ b) = b @ a"
proof (induction a arbitrary: b)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by simp
next
  case (Cons y a)
  have "(rot ^^ length (y # a)) ((y # a) @ b) = (rot ^^ length a) (rot (y # (a @ b)))"
    by (simp add: funpow_Suc_right)
  also have "\<dots> = (rot ^^ length a) (a @ (b @ [y]))" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = (b @ [y]) @ a" using Cons.IH by simp
  also have "\<dots> = b @ (y # a)" by simp
  finally show ?case by simp
qed

lemma rot_pow: "(rot ^^ length xs) xs = xs"
  using rot_iter[of xs "[]"] by simp

lemma rot_replicate: "rot (replicate n y) = replicate n y"
proof (cases n)
  case 0
  then show ?thesis by simp
next
  case (Suc m)
  have "rot (replicate (Suc m) y) = replicate m y @ [y]" by simp
  also have "\<dots> = replicate (Suc m) y" by (rule replicate_append_same)
  finally show ?thesis using Suc by simp
qed

lemma cyc_fixed: "as @ [y] = y # as \<Longrightarrow> \<exists>n. as = replicate n y"
proof (induction as)
  case Nil
  then show ?case by (intro exI[of _ 0]) simp
next
  case (Cons a bs)
  have h: "a = y \<and> bs @ [y] = a # bs" using Cons.prems by simp
  hence ay: "a = y" and bsy: "bs @ [y] = y # bs" by auto
  obtain n where bn: "bs = replicate n y" using Cons.IH[OF bsy] by blast
  show ?case using ay bn by (intro exI[of _ "Suc n"]) simp
qed

lemma rot_fixed:
  assumes "rot xs = xs" and "xs \<noteq> []"
  shows "\<exists>y. xs = replicate (length xs) y"
proof (cases xs)
  case Nil
  with assms(2) show ?thesis by simp
next
  case (Cons y ys)
  have "ys @ [y] = y # ys" using assms(1) Cons by simp
  then obtain n where "ys = replicate n y" using cyc_fixed by blast
  thus ?thesis using Cons by (intro exI[of _ y]) simp
qed

begin

lemma rot_mem:
  assumes xs: "xs \<in> SS p" and p0: "0 < p"
  shows "rot xs \<in> SS p"
proof -
  from xs have sub: "set xs \<subseteq> G" and len: "length xs = p" and ev: "lprod xs = e" by auto
  from len p0 obtain y ys where xs': "xs = y # ys" by (cases xs) auto
  from sub xs' have yG: "y \<in> G" and ysG: "set ys \<subseteq> G" by auto
  have P: "lprod ys \<in> G" by (rule lprod_closed[OF ysG])
  have yP: "y \<cdot> lprod ys = e" using ev xs' by simp
  have Py: "lprod ys \<cdot> y = e" by (rule comm_inv[OF yG P yP])
  have rot_eq: "rot xs = ys @ [y]" using xs' by simp
  have "lprod (ys @ [y]) = e" using lprod_snoc[OF ysG yG] Py by simp
  moreover have "set (ys @ [y]) \<subseteq> G" using ysG yG by auto
  moreover have "length (ys @ [y]) = p" using len xs' by simp
  ultimately show ?thesis unfolding rot_eq by simp
qed

end

section \<open>Counting the tuples\<close>

lemma card_SS_eq:
  assumes fin: "finite G" and p0: "0 < p"
  shows "card (SS p) = card G ^ (p - 1)"
  sorry

end
